You come for Night City, you stay for the people and the story in it. Hours later you’re still thinking about Judy, about Panam, Reed, and that bastard Johnny squatting your skull, who somehow you miss when he goes quiet. Behind every throwaway gig hides a story that catches you by the throat when you least expect it. The city never sleeps: neon in the rain, a radio crackling in your ride, a Kabuki alley that swallows you whole for the night. And in hand, it’s pure joy: hack, shoot, floor it, and never want to stop. If you dropped it at launch, come back. This is one of the game masterpieces of a lifetime that would deserve a whole alley in a museum gallery alongside legendary artists.

Cyberpunk 2077 hadir dengan premis naratif yang kuat dan eksekusi dunia yang solid, meskipun sempat melalui rilis awal yang penuh kacau. Daya tarik utama game ini sekarang terletak pada bagaimana CD Projekt Red konsisten merawat dan memperbaiki gamenya secara transparan. Mereka tidak membiarkan komunitasnya mati begitu saja setelah sempat hancur lebur (POIN TERBAIK UNTUK CDPR), melainkan membuktikan komitmen lewat perbaikan total hingga versi terbarunya berdiri sebagai sebuah masterpiece. Contoh paling nyatanya bisa dilihat dari stabilitas teknis di PC yang baik, berkurangnya bug gajelas, serta rombakan besar pada sistem combat, perks, dan Relic skills baru yang bikin kustomisasi build karakter makin seru.

Dari segi progres dan cerita, game ini menawarkan struktur naratif yang berkesan mendalam, terbukti dari total waktu main saya yang menyentuh angka 31 jam untuk menamatkan main story, DLC Phantom Liberty, dan sekitar 50% side quest (banyak banget side questnya). Perjalanan V dari awal menapaki kerasnya Night City hingga terseret konspirasi biochip Relic diracik dengan pacing emosional yang pas. Dinamika hubungan antara V dan Johnny Silverhand membuat alur utamanya hidup dan tidak terasa hampa. Terlebih lagi, pengalaman bermain game ini terasa semakin emosional dan perfectly nice setelah menonton serial anime Cyberpunk: Edgerunners setiap sudut jalanan Night City, mulai dari distrik Megabuilding hingga bar Afterlife, terasa punya nyawa dan sejarah kelamnya sendiri. [spoiler](Ada soundtrack anime yang masuk sebagai lagu, well played)[/spoiler]

Namun, puncak emosi dan nilai plus terbesar bagi saya pribadi terletak pada DLC Phantom Liberty dan dinamika karakternya, terutama Songbird/Song Seon-mi. Sejak awal, meskipun saya merasa ada gelagat yang janggal dan mencurigakan dari gerak-geriknya, kedekatan emosional membuat saya memilih untuk tetap bersama songbird. Saya mengabaikan segalapilihan berkhianat pada songbird di situasi apapun. Pilihan saya itu tetap setia di sampingnya sampai titik darah penghabisan, ngelewatin ketegangan dikejar agen NUSA, hingga benar-benar mengantarkannya terbang ke bulan. Momen perpisahan itu terasa sangat tulus, pilu, dan membekas sebagai salah satu cerita terbaik yang pernah saya mainkan. [spoiler]( ini terlalu subjektif karena saya emang cinta mati sama karakter Songbird pada saat pertama kali bertemu, Asian Supremacy)[/spoiler]

Melihat kualitas fondasi dunianya yang imersif ditambah dukungan jangka panjang yang solid dari sang developer, game ini jelas sangat layak dicoba. Perlu diingat, game ini menawarkan pengalaman emosional yang luar biasa bagi pemain yang fokus ke cerita. Kalau ada diskon wajib di beli bersama DLC Phantom Liberty-nya. Good Job CDPR! From a rocky start to a top-tier action RPG: Amazing redemption, but still room for polish.

Cyberpunk 2077 hardly needs an introduction: it’s an immersive first-person action-RPG set in the visually stunning, cutthroat metropolis of Night City. You play as V, a mercenary navigating a high-stakes story alongside Johnny Silverhand, building your character through cyberware, stealth, hacking, and intense gunplay.
A Remarkable Comeback
CD Projekt RED deserves huge credit for how far this game has come. Thanks to major updates
—most notably Patch 2.0—alongside the wave of hype from the Edgerunners anime, the game was truly given a second life. Today, it stands as a fantastic title that fully proves its worth.
Why It's Great Today:
Playstyle Variety: There are so many distinct ways to play. Whether you prefer pure netrunning, stealth, melee combat, or heavy firearms, the build progression feels deep and rewarding.
Night City remains one of the most impressively detailed and atmospheric open worlds in gaming history.

What Keeps It From Absolute Perfection:
Even though the game is in a great place, for a flagship AAA title, there are still minor physics details, vehicle interactions, and small technical quirks that could use one final polish update. Fleshing out these subtle environmental and mechanical details would truly elevate the overall immersion to the highest level.

Cyberpunk 2077 is a reborn masterpiece that is well worth your time and money. While we know major content additions have wrapped up, here's hoping CD Projekt RED might still drop a future update focused on these small micro-fixes to leave the game in absolute peak condition. Highly recommended!

My favorite game of all time with the worst updates of all time.

Firstly, i got much more stutters and crashes in 2.5, despite the game being pretty unstable even before the update. And im relativiely lucky, saw many posts about performance issues for previous updates too. For some reason they also massacred the HDR settings, "color saturation" setting is under "maximum brightness" (also there is something off with it, definitely not the same setting as from pre-2.5), and there is no actual maximum brightness and UI brightness settings which were there before. Not talking about blackfloor level, which is elevated in any game that i've played in HDR.
Why do u never test ur updates CDPR? Not only do u not test them, but u're also straight up lying: "Introduced various performance optimizations" and "Improved HDR rendering to provide more accurate colors, brightness, and contrast on compatible displays". Sure buddy.

Secondly, that got me thinking about the content they give to us. 
Look, we have an objectively unpolished game with a lot of bugs, unstable performance and literally an incomplete city, there are still many unfinished areas. 
Maybe instead of adding small cosmetic/gameplay features (of which i only use delamain service sometimes, and the clampdown quest is decent) and some random side quests, u could use the resources to complete Night City? Or finally optimize the game and fix the bugs so that it doesn't feel like playing a janky piece of code? Or maybe (just maybe) instead of all these updates u could make the infamous Crystal Palace DLC?

I would not complain about the content if u hadn't taken away the somewhat stable performance and HDR settings from me (again, performance issues were the case in previous updates too, i was just lucky), and vice versa, i would not complain about performance issues and HDR if we got something from what i mentioned above (as long as the game remained playable ofc). After all, the updates are free. But i got none of that.

The only update this game actually needed was 2.0 (apart from the earlier updates that fixed critical bugs from release).

Oh and yeah, maybe they'll release a patch that fixes HDR and performance in this update, but there shouldn't be broken updates in the first place, and my critique about the lack of meaningful content and unfixed game in general, combined with these broken updates, is still relevant.


P.S. Forgot to mention the performance in Dogtown. I understand that its a dense location filled with a lot of details, but both Jig Jig Street and the area behind Tom's Diner are working much better than Dogtown, despite also being very crowded.

By no means is Cyberpunk as perfect flawless game at this point in time, but I don't think any game is. What Cyberpunk definitely is, is a testament to how far CD Project Red is willing to go to fix what they feel they wronged. The game we have today is an entirely different beast than the one we had on launch. Whether that just be core gameplay mechanics, or the way the game itself looks and runs. At this point in time I can confidently say that Cyberpunk is my favorite game I've played in 2026 and I fully intend on playing it well into 27 & 28.
